name: Settings placement
author: Brett
description: Where each plugin's settings open (settings-placement@1): inside the plugin (slide-out pane, drop-down, tab, split view, inline section), a pop-up dialog, a floating window or the main Settings page, with a look and animation per placement. The framework draws them and the picker (every plugin's settings top row, its right-click Settings placement…, Settings → Plugins → Settings placement); this plugin keeps the picks on the console server, so they follow you between browsers and Claude, the API and the CLI can read and change them.

owner.description: plugin id (ai.amberx.axf.console.<plugin>) or its folder name

items.title: Set where one plugin's settings open

looks.description: per placement: { 'inside:pane': { animation, speed, easing, edge, size, position, dim, blur, radius, shadow } }
